name: placeholders-and-vanish-input

frames.best_why: Typed question is mid-dissolve with a visible spray of particles across the field.

tagline: Grey prompt rotates in a pill field, then typed words dissolve into dots.
summary: A rounded ask-anything field that cycles grey suggestion prompts every few seconds. Typing switches to white text and lights an arrow button, and submitting scatters the words into particles.
appearance: A pill-shaped dark grey field with a grey prompt inside and a small circular arrow button at its right end, sitting under a short white heading on a black stage. Typed text is white.
behaviour: The prompt fades upward and swaps to the next suggestion on a timer. Typing replaces it with white text and enables the arrow; submitting breaks the text into a cloud of dots that scatters sideways before the field empties.
demo_content: Heading 'Ask anything', prompts like 'What's on your mind today?', and typed lines about installing StashUI in Vite.
search_phrases: input that dissolves text into particles
pill search bar with arrow button
field where typed words scatter away
use_when: A search or ask field should feel playful and clear itself with a flourish after submit.
avoid_when: The dissolve needs a canvas and steady frame rate, and it wipes the typed value after submit.
customise: Pass the placeholders array and onChange and onSubmit handlers. The three-second cycle, pill styling and particle dissolve are fixed in the file.
weight_why: An 800px canvas is rescanned on every text change, with particles animated on submit.

a11y.note: The field has no label or aria-label, the arrow button has no name, and the text dissolve ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The arrow button has no accessible name and the field has no real label.
Prompts sit at low grey contrast against the dark pill.
polish_why: Clean pill with a satisfying dissolve; the grey prompt is faint and the icon button unlabelled.
title: Vanish Placeholder Input
